---
applyTo: "src/assets/i18n/*.json,src/app/**/*.html"
---

# Translations

Source: `src/CLAUDE.md` §Architecture (i18n).

When reviewing a change to these files:

- Every user-facing string goes through `ngx-translate` (`| translate`), never as literal text in
  a template. Literal UI text in an `.html` file is a finding.
- A new or renamed key must exist in **both** `src/assets/i18n/pl.json` and `en.json` in the same
  change. A key present in only one file is **blocking** — the other language shows the raw key.
- Keep the existing key style of the file being edited; do not restructure unrelated keys.
- PDF content is the exception: it is Polish and lives in the report builders, not in i18n.
